summary: Search the current checkout's source for ranked definitions.

help:
Usage: st search [OPTIONS] [query]...

  Search the current checkout's source for ranked definitions.

  ST is optional precision navigation for ranked discovery and current
  definitions. Use rg/rg --files for exact literals, regex, multiple needles,
  file enumeration and exhaustive references. Search before adding code and
  reuse a close match.

  Results are read from the current git checkout; -P <project> searches that
  project's registered root on this host instead.

  --text joins arguments into one case-insensitive literal phrase. --file
  lists that file's symbols independently of the query. --budget applies only
  to precision context. Whole-file reduction estimates are hypothetical whole-
  file baselines, not savings against a native search/read workflow. Narrow
  truncated results for more source.

Arguments:
  query...  Search query (symbol name, function, class, endpoint)

Options:
  -P, --project <str>   Search another project's registered local root instead
                        of the current checkout
  -b, --budget <int>    Token budget for precision prompt context only (not
                        primitives)  [default: 1200]
  -l, --limit <int>     Maximum primitive results  [default: 20]
  --offset <int>        Primitive result offset for text, symbols, or file
                        listings  [default: 0]
  --text                Join query arguments into one case-insensitive literal
                        phrase
  --symbols             Use the symbol search primitive
  -j, --json            Emit full JSON payload
  -f, --file <str>      List symbols in a file independently of the query
  --path <str>          Restrict to an existing in-root file/subtree (relative
                        or absolute)
  --hint / --no-hint    Show refinement hints when results are poor  [default:
                        hint]
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

usage.when: optional ranked discovery; search before adding code, extend a close match
precautions: rg/rg --files for exact literals, regex, multiple needles, file enumeration, exhaustive references
